Beneath entries about gales, wreckage, and the dead, he found a note in his own hand, written forty years earlier: a girl had come ashore that winter, carrying nothing but a brass button.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一台暂时调低音量的机器。高架桥下还有出租车缓缓滑过，尾灯在潮湿的路面上拖出暗红的线。便利店的白光守着犯困的店员，蒸笼冒着热气；环卫工把昨夜的纸杯与落叶收进车里。远处工地的塔吊沉默地立着，几扇窗忽然亮起，又很快熄灭。天边尚未泛白，第一班地铁已在地下醒来，载着零星乘客，穿过这座城未做完的梦。","w03":"• Recursion is when a set of instructions uses itself to solve a smaller piece of the same problem.\n• Imagine opening a box and finding another box inside: you repeat the same opening steps until you reach the tiniest box.\n• You always need a stopping rule, like opening the gift in the tiniest box, or the instructions would go on forever."}
